If a signer does not see a block within 500ms it can produce an out of turn block according to the spec. MIN_WAIT was discussed in EIP-2183 but was reject in favor of consistent block times. no OE is producing multiple blocks on the same level not competing blocks with others it competes with self ok I have a hunch (to be clear, my fork choice rule suggestion is for Clique alone) It's not just OE, Clique can halt w/o OE's extra blocks.
